title: Scale, units and naming
summary: Real-world size, units, which way models face, where origins go and how you name things.

request.brief: Model a simple prop at its real size, exactly as you would hand it over: a crate, a toolbox or a table lamp (about 20-60 cm). Name every object and collection the way you always do, set the origins where you want them, and leave transforms as you would deliver them.
must_include: Real-world size in the units you work in
Your own object and collection names (no Cube.001)
Origins placed where you put them on a delivered asset
request.submit: One .blend file. A second prop in a different shape makes the measurements more reliable.

questions.ask: Which way does the front of your models face?
Which engine or target are your models mainly for?
Anything about your naming that a file can't show (prefix rules, numbering, language)?
